confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on aggregator and travel-blog figures, mostly from other Moroccan cities (Marrakech, Casablanca, Chefchaouen, Taza) and a few Essaouira-specific pages. Restaurant meal anchors are the strongest. Beer, cocktail and wine anchors are weak: bar and wine-by-the-glass prices are inferred from luxury Marrakech hotel menus and retail data, then discounted for a mid-sized tourist town. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context, not from live listings or booking pages. Overall medium for food and drink, low for accommodation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are based on Moroccan tourist-town pricing (Essaouira-specific meal guides, plus Marrakech and Casablanca menus and aggregator data for beer, coffee and wine), adjusted down for a smaller coastal town. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from Essaouira's position as a mid-budget Moroccan coastal resort town, not from any searched source.
